[[Ajambo]] is a [[collector]], a type of [[NPC]] that exchanges [[Trophy|trophies]] for weapons.

==Locations==
*[[Kourna]]
**{{NPC location|Kodonur Crossroads|outpost}}

==Dialogue==
:''"My competitor, [[Kwesi]], keeps beating me from city to city. Her wagons are so light she makes the trip in less time, leaving me with nothing but the dregs of business. If you can retrieve for me 5 [[Sentient Lodestone]]s, I could secretly weigh her wagons down and then make the journey faster than she does. That would earn me a lot of money, I tell you, and I would gladly pass something valuable on to you:"''
